name: FIG-Eval
description: FIG-Eval is a benchmark spanning ten categories across perceptual, compositional, and temporal dimensions for evaluating factual image generation. It supports systematic evaluation of models that generate photorealistic and factually grounded images.
reputation: A recent benchmark for factual image generation that is emerging in the multimodal evaluation community.
notes: Benchmark designed to evaluate factual consistency and overall image quality in factual image generation.
